mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(s.school, '未填写') AS name, COUNT(*) AS payCount, IFNULL(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS income FROM edu_payment p JOIN edu_student s ON s.id = p.student_id WHERE (#{tenantId} IS NULL OR p.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND p.pay_time >= #{begin} AND p.pay_time < #{end} GROUP BY s.school ORDER BY income DESC

SELECT t.name AS name, t.subject AS subject, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS payCount, IFNULL(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS income FROM edu_payment p JOIN edu_enroll e ON e.id = p.enroll_id AND e.teacher_id IS NOT NULL JOIN edu_teacher t ON t.id = e.teacher_id WHERE (#{tenantId} IS NULL OR p.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND p.pay_time >= #{begin} AND p.pay_time < #{end} GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.subject ORDER BY income DESC

SELECT s.name AS name, s.school AS school, COUNT(*) AS payCount, IFNULL(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS income FROM edu_payment p JOIN edu_student s ON s.id = p.student_id WHERE (#{tenantId} IS NULL OR p.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND p.pay_time >= #{begin} AND p.pay_time < #{end} GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.school ORDER BY income DESC

SELECT t.name AS name, t.subject AS subject, COUNT(sch.id) AS scheduleCount, IFNULL(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, sch.start_time, sch.end_time)) / 60, 0) AS scheduledHours, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sch.status = 1 THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, sch.start_time, sch.end_time) ELSE 0 END) / 60, 0) AS completedHours, COUNT(DISTINCT sch.student_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT sch.clazz_id) AS dutyCount FROM edu_teacher t LEFT JOIN edu_schedule sch ON sch.teacher_id = t.id AND sch.status != 2 AND sch.start_time >= #{begin} AND sch.start_time < #{end} WHERE (#{tenantId} IS NULL OR t.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND t.status = 1 GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.subject ORDER BY scheduledHours DESC

SELECT c.name AS name, COUNT(sch.id) AS scheduleCount, IFNULL(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, sch.start_time, sch.end_time)) / 60, 0) AS hours FROM edu_schedule sch JOIN edu_course c ON c.id = sch.course_id WHERE (#{tenantId} IS NULL OR sch.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND sch.status != 2 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY hours DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(p.pay_time, '%m-%d') AS name, IFNULL(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS income, COUNT(*) AS payCount FROM edu_payment p WHERE (#{tenantId} IS NULL OR p.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND p.pay_time >= #{begin} AND p.pay_time < #{end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(p.pay_time, '%m-%d') ORDER BY MIN(p.pay_time)
